findings: The RealWorld.fi / ActualSales numbered two-row table (01/02 + label + description) is the closest thing to a feature-list on the page; it's dressed as an editorial index rather than cards, but structurally it still echoes a 'what I do' grid.

The lower sections (§2, §3) lean hard on dense small-mono text blocks that function more as texture than as readable copy — at this size several passages risk becoming decorative gray mass rather than legible content.

The §3 generative star-trail spiral is visually busy and nearly monochrome; the warm orange thread that ties the rest of the palette together almost vanishes there, weakening the otherwise disciplined color system in that one viewport.
what_works: The hero is a genuine composed system: an oversized high-contrast Didone 'André Macedo' anchored top-left against an asymmetric long-exposure orange arc over the Barcelona skyline, with the 'arc of sun / plate held open' concept literally embodied in the light trail — not a centered headline over a background.

The Daguerre passage uses strikethrough on 'every carriage and every walker passed through' to render people passing 'without a trace' — a real typographic risk and editorial conviction a template generator would never reach for.
Intentional, expressive type pairing (Didone display + Iowan body + mono utility voice) on an explicit 4:3 modular scale from 13.5→135px, confirmed by the rhythmic display→heading→body→caption steps.

A single warm-orange accent governed against deep indigo and cream, used sparingly on emphasis words ('stood still', 'comes back') and index numbers — restrained, named harmony rather than rainbow or purple-gradient default.

Stranger test is cleanly satisfied in the first viewport: name, the one-line 'Co-founder of RealWorld.fi and ActualSales', and a visible 'write me@andremacedo.com' email all legible without scrolling.
A.reasoning: This is an editorial art-organism, not a SaaS shape: asymmetric Didone-led hero, long-exposure photographic anchor tied to the page's conceptual frame, a risky strikethrough typographic move, and a disciplined warm-on-indigo palette. It avoids every cardinal slop state — no centered purple-gradient template, no system sans, no feature-card trio — and carries at least one decisive signature move. Minor demerits for the structurally feature-list-like business table and the dense small-mono texture in the mid sections, but the hero, type craft, and clear stranger-test identity push it comfortably above threshold.

findings: multiple competing focal points across long vertical scroll (hero light trail, large Daguerre quote, pinhole diagram, bottom interactive plate all pull eye with near-equal weight)
some ad-hoc type sizing rather than a strict modular scale (headline sizes feel intuitive but not rigorously ratio-bound)
certain sections lean on safe centered typography blocks that border on editorial template comfort
what_works: hero light-painting arc against night sky is a decisive, signature aesthetic move that no templated generator would produce
cohesive long-exposure / photographic-plate metaphor executed across type, diagrams, and interaction without becoming literal garnish
restrained color palette (deep indigo, warm amber trails, off-white ground) governed by a clear conceptual harmony
expressive pairing of refined serif display with crisp sans utility that feels intentional and editorial
stranger_test cleared immediately in first viewport with name, roles, and contact
B.reasoning: The desktop render is a strong, conceptually coherent living document that earns its non-slop status through the decisive long-exposure light-trail hero and the consistent photographic-plate metaphor that governs every section. It avoids the cardinal SaaS-landing and safe-default-sans traps. However it is not yet exceptional on every axis: focal hierarchy fractures across the long scroll, type scale is good but not rigorously modular, and some compositional choices remain comfortably centered. The overall craft is well above mediocre but still has visible room to ratchet tighter on hierarchy and rhythmic precision. Mobile version preserves the core moves without collapse.
